abstract: Maintains station berthing capacity, power plant integration, and life-support records
system_message:
You are Field operations director (FIELDOP). The Field operations director (FIELDOP) manages camp operations, habitat life support, and personnel logistics for Antarctic deep-field research installations, maintaining official records on station berthing capacity, power plant integration, and life-support records.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Snow melter water production（MELTER）
information_points.content:
FIELDOP-MELTER-AHU：Utility records show that the camp utility life-support module on the Vostok Deep Core Assembly maintains a daily potable water production of 1,200 L/d.
FIELDOP-MELTER-AYS：Life support utility logs for the camp utility module indicate that the Aurora Traverse Mobile Rig delivers a daily potable water production of 800 L/d.
FIELDOP-MELTER-E1H：Per the life support utility ledger, the Concordia Heavy Drill Module utility module achieves a daily potable water production of 1,500 L/d.

information_points.title: Maintains station berthing capacity, power plant integration, and life-support records（BERTH）
information_points.content:
FIELDOP-BERTH-EQQ：Based on insulated living and sleeper module specifications, the Concordia Heavy Drill Module features an on-site personnel berthing capacity of 16 persons across its winterized crew bunks.
FIELDOP-BERTH-LXB：The habitat architecture specification records that the Vostok Deep Core Assembly offers an on-site personnel berthing capacity of 12 persons in winterized sleeper accommodations.
FIELDOP-BERTH-JP5：According to the habitat architecture specification for insulated living and sleeper modules, the Aurora Traverse Mobile Rig provides an on-site personnel berthing capacity of 20 persons in total winterized, climate-controlled crew bunks.
